question.description: The user's research question in their own words (shown on the plan; not used by the rules).

goal.description: compare = do groups (or paired measurements) differ; relate = how the outcome goes with predictors; predict = predict the outcome. auto: compare when every group variable splits rows into groups (at most two), else relate.

outcomes.description: Outcome variable. Two or more numeric columns without groups = the same cases measured more than once (paired / repeated, wide form).

id.description: Case ID column, when the data are long (one row per measurement): repeated IDs mean repeated measures.

design.description: For two or more outcome columns: paired = same cases measured twice or more; independent = two different variables (relation). auto guesses from names such as x_pre/x_post.
